description: Sergi Brosa is a Spanish concept artist and illustrator based in Barcelona. Known for his dynamic, futuristic style, he specializes in sci-fi character, vehicle, and environment design. His work includes contributions to major projects like Borderlands 3 , and he’s also the creator of original universes such as Fury Beats and Atomic Delivery , blending punk aesthetics with vibrant storytelling.
